newsitem.title: USA: EG&G Inc president/COO Fred Parks resigns.
newsitem.headline: EG&G Inc president/COO Fred Parks resigns.

text.p: Fred Parks said he has as president and chief operating officer of EG&G Inc, effective Friday.

Parks joined EG&G in 1976, and held several positions in technical and executive management. As executive vice president and later as president, he had overall responsibility for the products and services provided by EG&G business segments.

The company said it has a "strong, seasoned management team in place. The management structure effected by Dr. Parks the first of this year will facilitate the smooth transition to a new chief operating officer."
